overview: Gives offline-mode players a face: a PNG on the server named after them, or the skin their name really owns, fetched from Mojang.

1.0.1: The two settings on the mods screen are named the way they read, and the mod says plainly that Pandorical is required on the server.
1.0.0: An offline server mints its own UUIDs, so nobody carries textures and everybody is Steve. This dresses each player on join: a file in the skins folder wins, otherwise the skin their name really owns is fetched by name.
